The target video is live-action and cinematic, a rain-slick neon-lit night alley with pink and blue signs, steam rising from a grate and wet reflective ground.
[Shot 1] A vertical full-length shot frames <Subject 1> standing centred in the alley, breathing steadily, her gloved hands loose at her sides, looking into the lens with a cool, level expression that hardens into fierce focus. The camera pushes in slowly toward her. Her eyes begin to glow, brightening to a blinding white-blue light. Thin forks of electric lightning spark from her shoulders and hands, then grow into bright crackling bolts arcing around her body and up into the air, lighting the wet walls in flashing blue. Her teal hair lifts and floats outward with the static charge, the puddles at her feet reflect every flash, and the steam swirls around her as the energy builds.
